Senses.Explanation: Rolling along and letting things run recurs in verses and addresses for an unforced daily course, including eating at meal times and knowingly appearing simple. The exact order occurs 87 times in 64 files and works; its reversed order occurs 150 times in 100 files and works. The Anquan lyric joins morning gruel and the midday meal to both orders, then says that inwardly one knows clearly while outwardly feigning foolishness. Yuanwu Keqin places the phrase after ‘thoroughly ordinary’; Gaofeng repeats both orders for a person with no household property to return to and nothing named Chan to study; Feiyin applies the doubled formula to walking, standing, sitting, lying, dressing, and eating. The records make an ordinary adverbial phrase into a rhythmic, reversible description, not a named procedure.
